notes: v3 fixes the floor plate and moves the sight to the right place but the blade was misplaced by a build bug.

defects.text: 6,704 tris, 12% over the 6,000 target, under the 10,000 maximum.
defects.fix: Lower sides on tori, ball, screws and stock rings.

defects.text: Rear sight still not legible. Measuring model.blend shows the sloped blade rs_blade sits at z 0.038-0.049 (inside the stock) instead of 0.067-0.075: setting rotation after creation and re-parenting into the RearSight group displaced it. Only the base, grey slider, notch plate and floating ticks are visible. Notch apex now at y 0.20, so the 0.50 m sight radius is right.
defects.fix: Build the blade as a profile mesh with explicit vertex coordinates (no object rotation).

defects.text: Floor plate is now thin and flush with the stock, the guard bow is slightly heavier; reads as one assembly.
Bayonet lug still a block on top of the nose cap.
defects.fix: Lug under the nose cap, cleaning rod stub lower in front.

defects.text: No handguard break. Accepted: the single smooth wood mass reads as the handguard at game distance and a seam would cost triangles for no visible gain.
defects.fix: Documented in spec.md as deliberately simplified.

defects.text: Scratch/chip texture on blued parts is coarse (shared texture).
defects.fix: Deferred: needs a purpose-made blued steel texture. Flag to the user.
